audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradicted their own prose: level 1 read Skill while whys[0] says he pokes you for free, level 6 read Skill while whys[4] calls The Culling your spike, first item read Jayce while whys[5] explicitly says 'Skill decides it', and 2+ items read Jayce while whys[6] says you out-DPS him.
audit.why: The mirror has already set both of its layers to Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Lucian, Skill, Lucian, which matches the packet chart.
audit.corrected: win[0], win[4], win[5], win[6] flipped with their phases[N].side partners as one atomic group, ratings moved, and the four contradicting phases[N].why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Blow is the thing you are told to bait on every page field, with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Thundering Blow is 20/18/16/14/12/10s — twenty seconds at rank 1. That is an enormous window and it is the single number that makes 'bait the knockback, then commit' worth doing. Acceleration Gate also increases Shock Blast's missile speed, range AND damage, which the page gestures at without stating.
audit.corrected: The 20s figure into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, mid and wants.you[2]; the gate's three effects into report[5].t and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers hang the matchup on 'commit when Relentless Pursuit is up' and treat it as a fixed 16-second timer.
audit.why: Lightslinger attacks REDUCE Relentless Pursuit's cooldown. It is not a stopwatch — a Lucian who is free-hitting the wave gets the dash back continuously, and a Lucian poked off the wave does not. In a lane whose whole problem is being kept away from minions, that inverts the advice: farming is what keeps your escape charged. This is the same find the mirror led with.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, early and mid.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Shock Blast out-ranges your 500-unit Q at level 1 and you have no dash yet, so he pokes you for free all wave.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: The Culling is your spike — pin him after a whiffed Thundering Blow and execute before he swaps stance.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: First item is a coin-flip: an even Lucian bursts him in hammer range, a fed Jayce pokes you out before you close.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: With items you out-DPS him in melee — E-reset chains and double-taps shred him where cannon poke cannot reach.

edits.before: Track Jayce’s Shock Blast: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Shock Blast through the gate gains speed, range AND damage. Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 — bait it and the gap is yours.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E dash for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — gate-accelerated poke; stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. - Relentless Pursuit is 16s but Lightslinger attacks refund it — hit the wave to keep it charged.

edits.before: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Thundering Blow is 20s: bait it first.

edits.before: Bait out his hammer E knockback, then E-dash in and W-mark for the move-speed to stick the kill
edits.after: Bait Thundering Blow — 20s at rank 1 — then E in and W-mark him for the move speed to stick

edits.before: Jayce simply out-ranges you here and you have no gap-closer to fix it — his cannon Q fired through the acceleration gate hits harder and further than your Piercing Light, and every step you take into Q range to last-hit gets you chunked below your already-low base HP. Don't try to win the poke war; you lose it. Hug the wave, take CS with the tip of your Q from max range, and refuse to walk up when his cannon Q is up. Your Lightslinger double-tap means nothing if you can't get into auto range.
edits.after: Jayce out-ranges you here and you have no gap-closer to fix it — Shock Blast fired through the Acceleration Gate gains missile speed, range AND damage, and every step into that line chunks your already-low base HP. Don't try to win the poke war; you lose it. Hug the wave, take CS with the tip of your 500-range Q, and refuse to walk up while Shock Blast is loaded. Keep hitting minions anyway: Lightslinger attacks refund Relentless Pursuit, so a farmed Lucian has the dash a poked one does not.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you can finally start looking for a window — if Jayce burns his hammer E knockback to disengage or you bait it, that's your cue to E-dash in, W-mark him, and unload a double-shot burst inside hammer range where his poke falls off. At 6 The Culling becomes a genuine execute threat: catch him after a whiffed E and R can finish him before he stance-swaps to a safe escape. But be honest — if you're already down two recalls of poke from the early phase, you don't have the HP to commit, and he just E-knocks you out of your own all-in.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you can finally look for a window — if Jayce burns Thundering Blow (20s at rank 1) to disengage, or you bait it out, that is your cue to E in, W-mark him, and unload a double-shot burst inside hammer range where his poke falls off. Relentless Pursuit is 16s on paper, but every Lightslinger attack refunds part of it, so farming the wave is what keeps the dash charged. At 6 The Culling is a genuine execute: catch him after a whiffed E and finish him before he stance-swaps out. Two recalls down on poke, don't commit at all.

notes: The headline fix matches the mirror's: Relentless Pursuit is not a 16-second stopwatch — Lightslinger attacks refund it, which means in a poke lane the dash you need to survive is paid for by the CS he is denying you. Four chart rows contradicted their own whys and are flipped as one atomic group onto the mirror's chart. Thundering Blow's 20-second rank-1 cooldown is the number that makes the bait-and-commit plan concrete.
